استنصرن (form X)
# اِسْتَنْصَرْنَ (istanṣarna) /is.tan.sˤar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
# اُسْتُنْصِرْنَ (ustunṣirna) /us.tun.sˤir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
# اِسْتَنْصِرْنَ (istanṣirna) /is.tan.sˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
